messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(7 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. Separately: recovery-small test_110m exists specifically to race a resent OUT RPC against the original that is still executing (it is what produced the LU-20878 trace, where ptlrpc_server_request_add() found the original as a duplicate and both copies were still executed). With this change the forced reconnect is refused while the original sleeps in CFS_RACE (which times out after 5s), so the resend only arrives after the original has finished, and test_110m no longer exercises ptlrpc_server_check_resend_in_progress() at all. Is the duplicate-detection hole itself going to be root-caused, and should there be a test that exercises the new -EBUSY refusal?

commit.message:
LU-20878 ldlm: refuse MDS-MDS connection on busy export

curently we do not block MDS-MDS reconnection if export is running
an RPC (not sure why). this may lead to re-execution of already
executed RPC which is bad, very bad.
